# ppk2-lib

> A Python library and command-line tool for Nordic's Power Profiler
> Kit II (PPK2). It records current and eight digital inputs at 100,000
> samples per second, to a CSV identical to the Power Profiler app's
> export or to a session file in the app's `.ppk2` format, in Ampere meter or
> Source meter mode, and it switches power to the device under test
> (DUT) from a script.
> Experimental: the API may change between 0.x versions. Not on PyPI
> yet; install from git.

The command and the import name are `ppk2`; the distribution is
`ppk2-lib`. Three layers: `ppk2.protocol` (standard library only),
`ppk2.client` (pyserial) and `ppk2.cli` (typer). Only one program can
hold the PPK2: close Nordic's app before capturing. A capture switches
the DUT on as it starts; the boot is about 0.1 s into the file. Power
ends with the command; `ppk2 power on --hold` keeps it. The modes, the
DUT and the digital inputs are named as in Nordic's app and user guide.

## Docs

Three parts: using it, how it measures, validation against Nordic's app.

- [README](README.md): install, a first capture, where everything is
- [Introduction](docs/index.md): the three parts, what it is good for and what it is not for
- [Getting started](docs/use/getting-started.md): install, the two wirings, the digital inputs, a first capture, reading the file
- [The ppk2 command](docs/use/command.md): every command and option, exit codes, signals
- [Recipes](docs/use/recipes.md): flashing a DUT powered by the PPK2, energy of a marked region, long captures, comparing two builds
- [Architecture](docs/use/architecture.md): the three layers, the life of a session, the capture callback, settings, threads, design choices
- [API reference](docs/use/api.md): discovery, Session, stream parser, calibration, commands
- [Troubleshooting](docs/use/troubleshooting.md): every error line and what to do
- [Measurement principle](docs/measure/principle.md): modes, ranges, calibration formula, spike filter, the 0.2 µA floor, time, digital inputs, accuracy
- [Protocol](docs/measure/protocol.md): the bytes and the behaviour of the PPK2, a session on the wire, known caveats
- [File formats](docs/measure/formats.md): the CSV and the `.ppk2` session file
- [Validation, method](docs/validation/method.md): the three levels of comparison with Nordic's app, the bench procedure
- [Validation, results](docs/validation/results.md): tables and plots per round, differences from the app, limits
- [Doc patterns](docs/contributing/doc-patterns.md): where each kind of documentation goes, Nordic's wording
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## Hardware tests

- [Running them](tests/hil/README.md): what the bench needs, in Ampere meter or Source meter mode
- [Bench firmware](tests/hil/bench-dut/README.md): the signal the tests expect, pins per dev kit, build and flash

## Validation

- [Comparison scripts](validation/README.md): statistics of two captures, and when the limits fit

- [Noise-floor round](validation/evidence/noise_floor_gui/README.md): the 0.2 µA floor against the app
